subject: Rent cap should stay strong
issue: Another rent increase notice arrived this month and it is more than my raise at work.
ask: Please keep the annual rent cap strong and close any loopholes that let landlords avoid it.
actionable_reason: Asks council to protect the annual rent cap

subject: Concerns about the proposed rent cap
issue: I own a duplex and I am worried that a lower annual cap will leave me unable to cover repairs.
detail: My property taxes and insurance have gone up every year, and the cap has not kept pace with those costs.
ask: Please let the council consider a cap formula that covers my real operating costs.
actionable_reason: Requests cap formula that covers operating costs

subject: Tope de renta anual
issue: Mi renta subió otra vez este año y ya no alcanza para la comida y la luz.
detail: Mi casero ni siquiera explicó por qué subió tanto, y cada año es lo mismo.
ask: Les pido que mantengan el tope anual de renta y que no permitan excepciones para los dueños.
actionable_reason: Pide mantener el tope anual de renta

subject: Rent increase again
issue: Every spring the notice comes and the new number is always higher than what I can comfortably pay.
detail: I have lived in my unit for six years and I have never once been late on rent.
The last increase made me cut back on medicine for my mother.
ask: Please keep the yearly cap in place and make sure it covers every type of rental.
actionable_reason: Asks council to keep the yearly rent cap.

subject: Rules feel heavy for small owners
issue: I think the rent rules have gotten too heavy for people who own only one or two units.
ask: Please think about small owners before you make the rules any stricter.
actionable_reason: General opinion without a specific request

subject: Xin giữ mức tăng tiền thuê
issue: Tiền thuê nhà của gia đình tôi vừa tăng thêm gần bốn trăm đô mỗi tháng.
ask: Tôi mong hội đồng giữ giới hạn tăng tiền thuê hằng năm và siết chặt việc thi hành.
actionable_reason: Yêu cầu giữ giới hạn tăng tiền thuê

subject: Small property manager concerns
issue: My company manages about forty small buildings and a stricter cap would push some owners to sell.
detail: Some of my clients have already told me they cannot keep up with maintenance costs under the current limit.
ask: Please add a hardship process so owners facing real losses can request a higher increase.
actionable_reason: Asks for hardship process for owners

subject: How is the cap calculated?
issue: I got a notice saying my increase is within the limit, but I cannot figure out how the number was calculated.
detail: The notice listed a percentage but did not show the base amount or the date it applies.
ask: Please require landlords to show the calculation on every rent increase notice.
actionable_reason: Requests clear calculation on rent notices

subject: Preocupación por el tope de renta
issue: Tengo una casa con dos cuartos para rentar y el tope actual no me deja cubrir la reparación del techo.
ask: Les pido que revisen la fórmula del tope para que tome en cuenta los gastos reales del dueño.
actionable_reason: Pide revisar la fórmula del tope

subject: Yearly increase too high
issue: My rent jumped in August and nothing about my building or my pay justified it.
ask: Please enforce the yearly cap so families can plan their budgets.
actionable_reason: Asks council to enforce the yearly cap

subject: Which rent limits apply to my unit?
issue: I rent out a condo I bought ten years ago and I am still confused about which rent limits apply to it.
detail: The city website explains the cap in general terms, but I could not find a clear answer for units built after a certain year.
I have called the office several times and waited on hold for a long time.
ask: Please publish a simple chart showing which rental units are covered by the cap and which are exempt.
actionable_reason: Requests chart of covered and exempt units

subject: Fees hidden inside the rent
issue: Our building manager raised rent by the maximum allowed and then added a new monthly trash fee on top.
detail: That fee was not in our lease, and the increase came right after we asked for a repair that never got done.
ask: Please make sure fees count toward the rent cap so landlords cannot shift costs around it.
actionable_reason: Asks fees count toward the rent cap

subject: Ý kiến về giới hạn tăng tiền thuê
issue: Tôi cho thuê một căn nhà nhỏ và chi phí bảo trì, bảo hiểm tăng liên tục nên giới hạn hiện nay làm tôi khó xoay sở.
detail: Tôi đã phải hoãn sửa mái nhà hai năm vì không đủ tiền thu từ tiền thuê.
ask: Tôi đề nghị hội đồng xem xét cho phép tăng thêm khi chủ nhà có chi phí thực tế được chứng minh.
actionable_reason: Cho phép tăng khi chi phí thật tăng

subject: Insurance costs and the cap
issue: Our small rental business cannot absorb a cap that stays flat while insurance keeps climbing.
ask: Please build in an adjustment for insurance and repair costs when setting the cap.
actionable_reason: Asks for insurance cost adjustment in cap

subject: Rent went up again
issue: Another increase notice showed up in my mailbox and I am tired of guessing what the next one will be.
detail: I have rented in the same place for nine years, and the total increase now is almost a third of my monthly pay.
ask: I hope the council keeps caring about renters when it reviews these rules.
actionable_reason: General feelings about rent, no specific request

subject: Eviction after I asked for repairs
issue: After I reported a broken heater to the landlord, I got a notice ending my tenancy with no reason given.
detail: My kids have been sleeping in coats because the unit stays so cold, and I have a copy of every text I sent.
I went to a legal aid clinic and they said I might have some protection, but the process is confusing and expensive.
ask: Please fund free legal help for tenants who get eviction notices after requesting repairs.
actionable_reason: Asks council to fund tenant legal help

subject: Desalojo sin razón clara
issue: Recibimos un aviso de desalojo con un mes de plazo y no nos dieron ninguna razón por escrito.
detail: Mi esposo trabaja de noche y estamos buscando dónde vivir con tres niños, lo cual es muy difícil con este tipo de aviso.
ask: Les pido que hagan más fuertes las protecciones para familias que reciben avisos de desalojo sin causa.
actionable_reason: Pide protecciones fuertes contra desalojos sin causa

subject: Slow process for nonpaying tenants
issue: I am a homeowner renting out a room and the eviction process for nonpaying tenants takes months to finish.
ask: Please speed up the process for property owners who have documented unpaid rent.
actionable_reason: Requests faster process for documented nonpayment cases

subject: Afraid to report problems
issue: I am scared to complain about mold because the last person who did got a rent hike two weeks later.
ask: Please add stronger penalties for landlords who retaliate against tenants who report code problems.
actionable_reason: Asks penalties for landlord retaliation against reporting

subject: Lo sợ bị đuổi khỏi nhà
issue: Gia đình tôi nhận thông báo chấm dứt thuê nhà sau khi tôi phản ánh chuyện hệ thống nước bị rò rỉ.
detail: Chúng tôi đã ở đây bảy năm, con gái tôi đang học lớp chín và rất khó tìm nhà mới trong thời gian ngắn.
ask: Tôi mong thành phố có thêm quy định bảo vệ người thuê khi báo cáo việc sửa chữa.
actionable_reason: Bảo vệ người thuê khi có sửa chữa

subject: Notice rules for small building operators
issue: We run a small apartment building and I am not sure how many days notice we must give before filing for an eviction.
detail: Different staff members have given us different answers, and we want to follow the rules correctly.
ask: Please publish a one-page guide that lists the notice rules for small building operators.
actionable_reason: Requests a one-page notice-rules guide

subject: Three families got notices
issue: Three families in my building got eviction notices in the same month, and nobody told us why.
detail: Most of us have lived here for over a decade and we are all struggling to find something we can afford nearby.
ask: Please require a written reason and a relocation plan before a landlord can end a long tenancy.
actionable_reason: Asks written reason and relocation plan requirement

subject: Just-cause rules for owners
issue: I am a retired homeowner with one rental unit and I need to know the rules before I ever evict anyone.
ask: Please post clear just-cause rules so owners like me can follow them correctly.
actionable_reason: Requests clear just-cause rules for owners

subject: Aviso de desalojo por quejarme
issue: Me llegó un aviso de desalojo después de quejarme por la plaga de cucarachas en mi cocina.
ask: Les pido que castiguen a los caseros que quieren desalojar a quien reporta problemas de salud.
actionable_reason: Pide sanciones contra represalias de caseros

subject: Eviction after a complaint
issue: I was given thirty days to leave after I asked the office to fix the back door lock.
detail: The notice did not give a reason, and I believe it was because of the complaint I filed with the city.
My daughter has asthma and I cannot move her across town during the school year.
ask: Please pass protections that bar eviction notices filed within six months of a city complaint.
actionable_reason: Asks ban on evictions after city complaints

subject: Thanks for hearing renters
issue: I am a renter who really wants the council to care about people who get pushed out.
detail: Many of my friends have moved away from the area because of this problem, and I think that is sad.
ask: I hope the council keeps working on tenant protections in the coming months.
actionable_reason: General support with no specific request

subject: 关于租户保护的请求
issue: 我们一家住在出租屋里，房东突然发出搬离通知，没有说明理由。
ask: 希望市议会加强租户保护，禁止在没有正当理由的情况下驱逐租户。
actionable_reason: 要求禁止无正当理由驱逐租户

subject: Checklist for owners filing eviction
issue: I manage my late father's old duplex and I want to follow the eviction rules without making a mistake.
detail: I have been told that the notice period differs depending on the reason, and I would like a clear list of each reason.
ask: Please provide a checklist for owners who need to file for eviction.
actionable_reason: Requests owner eviction checklist from city

subject: Need help with a move-out notice
issue: My lease ended and the landlord says I must leave in two weeks even though I paid every month.
ask: Please fund a free city hotline that tenants can call when they get a surprise move-out notice.
actionable_reason: Asks free city hotline for tenant notices

subject: Paalis sa tinitirhan
issue: Nakatanggap kami ng abiso na kailangan naming umalis sa loob ng tatlumpung araw nang walang dahilan.
detail: Matagal na kaming nakatira dito at ang mga anak ko ay nasa malapit na paaralan, kaya napakahirap ang ganitong biglaang abiso.
ask: Hinihiling namin sa konseho na palakasin ang proteksyon laban sa paalis na walang dahilan.
actionable_reason: Hinihiling palakasin proteksyon laban sa sapilitang pag-alis

subject: Opposed to fourplexes next door
issue: I bought my house because the lot is quiet and I do not want a fourplex built on the lot next door.
detail: Our street has narrow parking and the driveways are already full on weekends.
ask: Please keep the current limits for single-family lots and require public notice before any change.
actionable_reason: Asks to keep limits, require public notice

subject: Support backyard units
issue: I want to build a small backyard unit so my parents can live close to us without moving far.
ask: Please keep the process for backyard units fast and make permit fees affordable.
actionable_reason: Asks faster backyard unit permits and lower fees

subject: Apoyo para más viviendas
issue: Mi hijo ya tiene familia y no puede encontrar un lugar para rentar cerca de nosotros, así que apoyo que se construyan más casas.
detail: Si se permite un cuarto extra o una unidad pequeña en el patio, muchas familias podrían quedarse en la ciudad.
ask: Les pido que faciliten los permisos para unidades pequeñas en los patios de las casas unifamiliares.
actionable_reason: Pide facilitar permisos para unidades pequeñas

subject: Sharing a two-bedroom
issue: I share a two-bedroom with my sister and her two kids because nothing else in our price range is available.
detail: If the city allowed more small buildings in areas that already have buses and sidewalks, we would have more options.
We are tired of waiting on lists that never seem to move.
ask: Please let fourplexes and small apartments be built on more lots so that families can find homes.
actionable_reason: Asks to allow fourplexes on more lots

subject: Keep single-family zoning
issue: I think single-family zoning is part of why our area still feels like a real community.
ask: I hope the council will think carefully before changing those rules again.
actionable_reason: General opinion without a specific request

subject: Ủng hộ nhà ở nhỏ trên lô đất
issue: Tôi muốn xây thêm một căn nhà nhỏ phía sau nhà để con cháu có chỗ ở gần mình.
detail: Thủ tục cấp phép hiện nay quá lâu và nhiều chi phí, làm nhiều gia đình nản chí.
ask: Tôi đề nghị thành phố đơn giản hóa thủ tục và giảm lệ phí cho nhà ở nhỏ phía sau.
actionable_reason: Giảm thủ tục và lệ phí cấp phép

subject: Garage conversions
issue: I have a rental unit with an old garage I would like to convert, but the rules make that almost impossible.
detail: The rules require a full setback review even for a small change, which adds months and thousands of dollars.
ask: Please let owners convert existing garages into homes without a lengthy extra review.
actionable_reason: Asks simpler garage-to-home conversion approvals

subject: Concerns about the density plan
issue: A plan to put several units on each lot would change how our block looks and feels within a few years.
detail: Our street has one lane of parking and the sewer line already backs up after big storms.
Adding that many families without new infrastructure would make both problems worse.
ask: Please require an infrastructure study before any upzoning proposal for residential lots gets a vote.
actionable_reason: Requires infrastructure study before upzoning votes

subject: More homes please
issue: Rents keep climbing because there are too few homes for the number of people who want to live here.
ask: Please approve more small multi-unit homes in every part of the city.
actionable_reason: Asks more small multi-unit homes citywide

subject: Question about fourplex rules
issue: I am thinking about adding a fourplex on my lot and I want to understand the rules before I spend money.
detail: Some neighbors told me the process has changed twice in the last few years.
ask: Could the city summarize recent fourplex rule changes in one place?
actionable_reason: Requests summary of recent fourplex rule changes

subject: Más vivienda accesible
issue: Mi familia vive en un cuarto y los precios siguen subiendo porque hay muy pocas casas disponibles.
ask: Les pido que permitan más casas pequeñas y edificios de cuatro unidades en toda la ciudad.
actionable_reason: Pide permitir casas pequeñas y edificios medianos

subject: Parking and traffic worries
issue: Every new building on our block adds more cars, and there is nowhere left to park after dinner.
ask: Please require off-street parking for every new home built in single-family areas.
actionable_reason: Requires off-street parking for new single-family-area homes

subject: Contractor supports smaller homes
issue: I run a small contracting business and I have turned down jobs because the current rules make small projects too expensive.
detail: Smaller projects would keep my crew busy and bring more homes onto the market faster.
ask: Please simplify the rules for adding one or two units on existing residential lots.
actionable_reason: Asks simpler rules for one or two units

subject: Cần thêm nhà ở
issue: Gia đình tôi có ba người phải ở chung một phòng vì giá thuê nhà quá cao.
ask: Tôi mong thành phố cho phép xây thêm nhà ở nhỏ ở nhiều khu dân cư hơn.
actionable_reason: Cho phép xây thêm nhà nhỏ

subject: Keep older blocks as they are
issue: The older houses on our block have character and I worry that new big buildings would erase it.
detail: Some of the homes here were built over a hundred years ago, and that history matters to the people who live here now.
ask: Please protect older single-family blocks from upzoning without a community meeting first.
actionable_reason: Asks community meeting before upzoning older blocks

subject: Vote yes on the housing bond
issue: I am a homeowner who believes we should fund affordable housing even if it costs me a little more in taxes.
ask: Please approve the affordable housing bond and make sure the money goes to projects quickly.
actionable_reason: Asks approval of bond and quick spending

subject: Bond money for families
issue: My daughter and I are on a waiting list for a subsidized unit that has been closed for two years.
detail: If the city reopens funding for new affordable units, families like ours would finally have a real chance.
ask: Please prioritize bond funding for new affordable apartments that serve extremely low-income households.
actionable_reason: Asks bond funds for extremely low-income housing

subject: Vivienda asequible para trabajadores
issue: Trabajo en una fábrica y mi sueldo no alcanza para pagar un departamento, aunque trabajo todos los días.
detail: Muchos compañeros duermen en carros o se mudan lejos porque no encuentran algo accesible.
Un fondo de vivienda asequible podría cambiar eso para la gente que trabaja todos los días.
ask: Les pido que aprueben el fondo de vivienda asequible y que den prioridad a los trabajadores de bajos ingresos.
actionable_reason: Pide aprobar el fondo de vivienda asequible

subject: Oppose the new housing bond
issue: I am opposed to another bond measure because our property taxes are already high and we are on a fixed income.
detail: I have seen past bonds take years to produce housing, and I want the city to show results before asking for more.
ask: Please delay any new housing bond until the city publishes results from the last one.
actionable_reason: Asks delay until last bond results published

subject: Where does the housing money come from?
issue: I keep hearing about affordable housing money, but I cannot tell where the funding comes from.
ask: Please publish a plain-language summary of where the affordable housing funding comes from.
actionable_reason: Requests plain-language summary of funding sources

subject: Ủng hộ quỹ nhà ở giá rẻ
issue: Tôi là chủ nhà ở đây nhiều năm và ủng hộ việc dùng quỹ để xây nhà giá rẻ cho người lao động.
detail: Con cái của nhiều hàng xóm phải chuyển đi xa vì không đủ tiền thuê nhà gần trường.
ask: Tôi mong hội đồng thông qua quỹ này và công khai tiến độ xây dựng.
actionable_reason: Thông qua quỹ và công khai tiến độ

subject: Developer perspective on funding
issue: Our company builds affordable apartments and we can only start projects when local funding is committed on time.
detail: Delays in approving gap financing have pushed two of our projects back by almost a year.
ask: Please approve gap financing on schedule so affordable projects do not stall.
actionable_reason: Asks timely gap financing approvals for projects

subject: Support funding for housing
issue: I work two jobs and still cannot afford a place that is not overcrowded.
ask: Please fund more affordable housing projects this year.
actionable_reason: Asks more affordable housing funding this year

subject: Bond measure is too expensive
issue: The new proposal would add a large tax on property owners, and I think the cost should be spread differently.
detail: My neighbors and I are retired and we already stretch to pay for our homes each year.
Some of us are considering selling because the bills keep going up.
ask: Please reconsider the funding plan and use general revenue instead of a new property tax.
actionable_reason: Asks general revenue instead of new property tax

subject: Apoyo al fondo de vivienda
issue: Yo soy dueño de mi casa y apoyo que se use dinero público para vivienda económica para nuestros vecinos.
ask: Les pido que aprueben el financiamiento y que informen cada año sobre los resultados.
actionable_reason: Pide aprobar financiamiento y reportar resultados

subject: Growth needs better sewers
issue: New housing is fine with me, but the sewer line on our street was not built for many more homes.
detail: When it rains hard the manhole covers bubble up, and I am worried about what happens with more connections.
ask: Please require sewer and water capacity checks before the council approves major new housing projects.
actionable_reason: Requires sewer capacity checks before housing approvals

subject: Schools are full
issue: The elementary school my son attends is already over capacity, and more housing will push it further.
ask: Please coordinate school capacity planning with any new housing approvals.
actionable_reason: Requests school capacity planning with housing approvals

subject: Parking can't keep up
issue: Our block has too few spots already, and the new apartments going up are not providing enough parking.
detail: Delivery trucks block the lane almost every morning, and I have had to park three streets away.
ask: Please require developers to pay for added parking or transit before new projects are approved.
actionable_reason: Requires developers to fund parking or transit

subject: Agua y drenaje para las casas nuevas
issue: Hay muchas construcciones nuevas y la tubería del agua en mi calle ya tiene fugas frecuentes.
ask: Les pido que revisen la capacidad de agua y drenaje antes de aprobar más proyectos.
actionable_reason: Pide revisar agua y drenaje antes de aprobar

subject: Trường học và nước sạch
issue: Nhà mới được xây nhiều nhưng trường học và hệ thống nước vẫn chưa được nâng cấp kịp.
detail: Con tôi học lớp đông hơn hai mươi học sinh và nước đôi khi bị yếu vào buổi tối.
ask: Tôi đề nghị thành phố kiểm tra sức chứa trường học và nước trước khi cấp phép thêm.
actionable_reason: Kiểm tra sức chứa trường và nước trước

subject: Support new homes with an infrastructure plan
issue: Our business depends on workers who need places to live, so I support new housing if it comes with real infrastructure planning.
detail: We have lost employees because they could not find anywhere to live nearby.
Better roads, sewers, and parking would make these projects work for everyone in the area.
ask: Please tie each major housing approval to a written plan for roads, water, and schools.
actionable_reason: Ties major housing approvals to infrastructure plans

subject: Just a thought on growth
issue: I am not against growth but I think the city should slow down a little and see what breaks first.
ask: I hope the council keeps a steady pace on new approvals.
actionable_reason: General opinion without a specific request

subject: Traffic from new buildings
issue: Since the new buildings went up, the corner by my kids' bus stop has gotten much busier at rush hour.
detail: Cars back up past the crosswalk and I have seen a few close calls with kids walking in the morning.
ask: Please add a traffic study and a safer crossing before more buildings are approved nearby.
actionable_reason: Requests traffic study and safer crossing

subject: Water and sewer capacity for new units
issue: I have been reading the staff reports and I do not see a clear plan for water and sewer service in our part of the city.
detail: Our water pressure drops during summer evenings, and I wonder how that will work with several new buildings on the same line.
I would like to know whether the utility has counted the new connections.
ask: Please publish the water and sewer capacity numbers that were used to approve each new project.
actionable_reason: Requests published water and sewer capacity numbers

subject: 关于新住房与基础设施
issue: 新建住房可以，但是我们这边的排水和供水设施跟不上了。
ask: 希望市政府在批准新项目前，先检查供水和排水能力。
actionable_reason: 要求批准前检查供水排水能力

subject: Streetlight out for weeks
issue: The streetlight in front of my house has been out for almost three weeks and the block is pitch black at night.
ask: Please repair the streetlight on my block and check the wiring for theft.
actionable_reason: Requests streetlight repair and wiring check

subject: Dark corner after dark
issue: Our corner has been dark since the lights went out last month, and I feel unsafe walking my dog after eight.
detail: I already reported it through the 311 app twice and I got an automated response both times.
ask: Please send a crew to restore the light and confirm when it is fixed.
actionable_reason: Requests crew to restore light and confirm

subject: Luz de la calle apagada
issue: La luz de la calle cerca de mi casa lleva más de un mes apagada y se oscurece todo el tramo.
detail: Ya la reporté en la aplicación 311 y nadie ha venido a repararla.
ask: Les pido que manden a alguien a repararla y revisen si se robaron los cables.
actionable_reason: Pide reparar la luz y revisar cables robados

subject: Copper wire theft again
issue: The lights on our side of the street keep going out because someone keeps stealing the copper wire from the poles.
detail: This is the third time since spring that we have been left in the dark for a week or more.
My wife and I are retired and we do not feel safe walking to the bus at night.
ask: Please replace the stolen wire with a theft-resistant design and check the poles on our side.
actionable_reason: Requests theft-resistant wiring design on poles

subject: Calle oscura en la noche
issue: Ya no puedo caminar a casa de noche porque la calle está completamente a oscuras desde hace semanas.
ask: Les pido que reparen la luz de inmediato porque hay niños que caminan por aquí.
actionable_reason: Pide reparar la luz de inmediato

subject: Đèn đường bị hỏng
issue: Đèn đường trước nhà tôi đã tắt hơn hai tuần nên đêm rất tối và đi lại không an toàn.
detail: Tôi đã báo qua ứng dụng 311 nhưng chưa thấy ai đến sửa.
ask: Tôi đề nghị thành phố cử người đến sửa đèn và kiểm tra dây điện có bị lấy trộm không.
actionable_reason: Sửa đèn và kiểm tra dây điện

subject: Lights out at our loading area
issue: Our loading area behind the shop has been dark for a month, and our delivery drivers are complaining.
ask: Please restore the streetlight near our loading area as soon as possible.
actionable_reason: Requests urgent streetlight restoration near business

subject: Streetlight out since the storm
issue: The light pole at the end of our street has been out since the last big storm and no one has come to fix it.
detail: I have seen city trucks parked nearby on other days, so this should not be hard to schedule.
ask: Please add this pole to the next repair list and tell us the date.
actionable_reason: Requests repair date for the pole

subject: Two lights down on my block
issue: Two of the four lights on our block are out and the other two flicker when it rains.
ask: Please check all four poles and replace the parts that are failing.
actionable_reason: Requests inspection and repair of four poles

subject: Cables robados de la luz
issue: Otra vez robaron los cables de la luz de la esquina y ahora la calle quedó sin alumbrado por varios días.
detail: Ya hemos reportado esto varias veces y nadie da una fecha de reparación.
ask: Les pido que reparen el alumbrado y pongan un diseño de cables que no se pueda robar fácilmente.
actionable_reason: Pide reparar alumbrado y cables antirrobo

subject: Light pole outage question
issue: The light at the bus stop near my house has been dim for a week and sometimes goes completely dark.
